objective: Implement offline-safe AI fallback behavior so meetings can continue through manual review when transcription or extraction is unavailable, while keeping pending AI states visible in the mobile shell.
environment_prerequisites: Flutter SDK is installed and available on PATH.
The existing mobile package shell remains under mobile/field_work_agent/.
success_criteria: Meetings can be moved into a manual-review path without requiring successful AI transcription or extraction.
Manual fallback preserves local editing of transcript, summary, minutes, and project links.
Pending AI and failed AI states are visible in the mobile meeting experience.
The work stays local-only and does not add sync or hosted backend assumptions.
stop_conditions: Flutter preflight fails and the task would require generated platform runners or runtime-only validation.
Completing the work would require changes to canonical product docs rather than implementation against them.
approval_gates: Adding new packages beyond the current Flutter dependencies.
Expanding scope into remote AI orchestration, sync, or multi-user behavior.
deliverables: Visible pending and failed AI states in the mobile meeting shell
Widget coverage for the fallback presentation
notes: Prefer reusing the existing review-state machine and editor behavior over introducing parallel status systems.
Use repo-level validation commands after the implementation is complete.
